kjv: he that hasteth with [his] feet sinneth
mine: whoever makes haste with his feet misses the way
note: Hebrew chote' has the basic sense "miss the mark" (cf. Judg 20:16); in this practical proverb it means to stumble or go astray, not moral sin.

kjv: let not thy soul spare for his (your son's) crying
mine: do not set your heart on putting him (your son) to death
note: Hebrew hamito is "his death" (hiphil of mut): discipline must not go as far as killing; the KJV read it as from hamah "moan", reversing the caution into "ignore his cries".
